content: Nai Jesus moris fila fali
Iha loron Domingu, dadeer-saan nakukun, Maria Madalena baa iha rate. Too iha nebaa, nia haree fatuk ida hodi taka rate nee muda sees tiha ona.
Nunee nia halai baa foo hatene Simão Pedro ho eskolante ida nebee Jesus hadomi liu nee. Nia dehan, “Ema foti tiha ona ita nia Nai nia mate isin husi rate, sira tau iha nebee ami la hatene.”
Nunee Pedro ho eskolante ida seluk nee baa iha rate.
Sira nain rua halai, maibee eskolante ida seluk nee halai makaas liu i nia mak too uluk iha rate.
Nia hakruuk hateke tama ba rate laran, nia haree hetan hena mutin nebee uza hodi falun mate isin, maibee nia la tama liu ba laran.
Simão Pedro too ikus, i nia tama kedas ba rate laran. Nia haree hena mutin nee iha nebaa.
Nia mos haree hena nebee mak ema bobar ba Jesus nia ulun, hena nee hikar tiha ona, la tau hamutuk ho hena seluk.
Depois eskolante ida nebee too uluk nee mos tama ba laran. Nia haree i fiar.
Iha tempu nebaa sira nain rua seidauk kompriende buat nebee hakerek nanis ona iha Livru Sagradu dehan Jesus tenki moris fali husi mate.
Depois eskolante nain rua nee fila ba uma.
Nai Jesus hatudu Aan ba Maria Madalena
Maibee Maria sei hamriik tanis hela iha rate oin. Tanis dadauk, nia hakruuk hodi hateke ba rate laran.
Nia haree anju rua hatais hena mutin. Sira tuur iha fatin nebee foin dadauk Jesus nia mate isin latan ba nee. Ida tuur iha ulun, ida seluk tuur iha ain.
Sira husu ba Maria, “Senhora, tansaa mak ita tanis?” Nia hataan, “Ema hasai tiha ona hau nia Nai nia mate isin, sira tau iha nebee hau la hatene.”
Koalia hotu tiha Maria hateke ba kotuk, nia haree Jesus hamriik hela iha nebaa, maibee nia la hatene katak nee Jesus.

Jesus husu nia dehan, “Senhora, tansaa mak ita tanis? Ita buka see?” Maria la konhese Jesus, nia hanoin toos nain mak koalia ho nia. Entaun nia husu fali dehan, “Senhor, se karik ita boot mak lori Nia baa tau fali iha fatin seluk, foo hatene mai hau, ita boot tau Nia iha nebee, atu hau bele baa foti Nia.”
Jesus hatete ba nia, “Maria!” Maria fila oin hodi hateke ba Jesus dehan, “Raboni”, iha lian Ebreu dehan “Mestri.”

Jesus dehan, “La bele kaer Hau, tanba Hau seidauk sae fali ba iha Hau nia Aman. Maibee baa foo hatene ba Hau nia maun-alin sira katak agora Hau atu sae fali ona ba iha Hau nia Aman, Nia mos imi nia Aman. Nia nee Hau nia Maromak ho mos imi nia Maromak.”
Nunee Maria Madalena baa foo hatene Jesus nia eskolante sira dehan, “Ohin hau haree ita nia Nai!” Depois nia foo hatene Jesus nia lia menon ba sira.
Nai Jesus hatudu Aan ba Nia eskolante sira

Iha Domingu kalan, Jesus nia eskolante sira halibur hamutuk, sira xavi odamatan metin tanba tauk nai ulun Judeu sira. Derepenti deit Jesus mai hamriik iha sira nia klaran hodi kumprimenta sira dehan, “Maromak foo pas ba imi!”
Koalia tiha nunee, Jesus mos hatudu Nia liman kanek ho sorin kanek ba sira. Bainhira sira haree sira nia Nai, sira kontenti teb-tebes.
Depois Jesus hatete ba sira dala ida tan, “Maromak foo pas ba imi. Hanesan Hau nia Aman haruka Hau mai, nunee mos Hau haruka imi baa.”
Depois Nia huu Nia iis ba sira hodi dehan, “Simu Espiritu Santu ba.
Se imi foo perdaun ba ema ruma nia sala, Maromak mos foo perdaun ba nia. Se imi la foo perdaun ba nia sala, Maromak mos la foo perdaun ba nia.”
Nai Jesus hatudu Aan ba Tomé
Husi Jesus nia eskolante nain sanulu resin rua, iha ida naran Tomé, baibain ema bolu Kaduak. Bainhira Jesus hatudu Aan ba Nia eskolante sira, Tomé nee la iha.

Nunee eskolante sira seluk dehan ba nia, “Ami haree tiha ona ita nia Nai!” Maibee Tomé hatete ba sira dehan, “Hau haree lai pregu fatin iha Nia liman hodi hatama hau nia liman fuan ba, i hau hatama lai hau nia liman ba iha Nia sorin kanek. Nee mak foin hau fiar!”

Liu tiha semana ida, Jesus nia eskolante sira halibur malu fali iha uma, Tomé mos iha nebaa. Odamatan xavi metin hotu, maibee Jesus mai hamriik iha sira nia klaran hodi kumprimenta sira dehan, “Maromak foo pas ba imi!”
Depois Jesus hatete ba Tomé, “Haree Hau nia liman, i hatama o nia liman fuan ba! Lolo o nia liman mai hodi hatama iha Hau nia sorin kanek nee. Keta duvida tan maibee fiar ba!”
Tomé dehan ba Jesus, “Hau nia Nai. Hau nia Maromak!”
Depois Jesus hatete ba Tomé, “O fiar tanba o haree tiha ona Hau. Maibee ema nebee fiar maski nia la haree Hau, nia hetan bensaun boot liu tan.”
Livru nee hakerek atu ema bele fiar ba Nai Jesus
Jesus halo milagre barak tan iha Nia eskolante sira nia oin hodi hatudu Maromak nia kbiit. Milagre sira nee la hakerek hotu iha livru nee.
Maibee buat sira nee hakerek atu imi bele fiar katak Jesus mak Mesias, Maromak nia Oan. Liu husi imi nia fiar ba Nia mak imi hetan moris rohan-laek.
